summary: Variant of the rolling update where a QA script runs from a separate testing server against each node (via delegate_to) before it is re-added to the pool; failed hosts can be redeployed using the retry file.
questions: How do I run a test script from a separate test server against each deployed node?
How do I redeploy only the servers that failed?

answer_card.title: Run tests from a testing server during rollout
answer_card.answer_md:
Delegate the test to a testing machine before re-adding the host:

```yaml
  roles:
    - common
    - webserver
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.script: /srv/qa_team/app_testing_script.sh --server {{ inventory_hostname }}
      delegate_to: testing_server
```

(with the same `serial`, `pre_tasks` and `post_tasks` load balancer steps). If some servers fail, fix them and use Ansible's generated retry file to rerun on just those hosts.
